ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent Clapton and Hendrix listening; I would choose this today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented songwriting appeals to me, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Fool To Care; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having listened to Memphis, I would be interested in another Boz Scaggs album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues-rock sound fits my interests, but I would keep today's choices limited.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and roots rock than pop vocals right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Get Up; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its blues direction fits my recent listening, but I am already choosing two albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Question Of Balance; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic rock appeals to me, though I am more curious about the blues albums today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dust Bowl; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Guitar-driven blues sounds appealing, but Different Shades Of Blue gets my attention first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Tour De Force: Live In London - Royal Albert Hall; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A live blues performance interests me, but I would try a studio album first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A mellow vocal album is less appealing than blues guitar for my current mood.
